powertrains.transmission: CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) or Manual Transmission

maintenance_items.notes: Oil change intervals derived from schedule milestones: 20k/24mo, 30k/36mo, 40k/48mo, 50k/60mo, 60k/72mo, 70k/84mo, 80k/96mo, 90k/108mo, 100k/120mo, 110k/132mo. Pattern shows every 10,000 miles / 12 months. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km).
Appears at every 5,000-mile / 6-month interval throughout the schedule. When rotating tires, check for damage and uneven wear.

Appears at 15k/18mo, 30k/36mo, 45k/54mo, 60k/72mo, 75k/90mo, 90k/108mo, 105k/126mo. Pattern is every 15,000 miles / 18 months. When driving for prolonged periods in dusty conditions, replace more frequently.
First inspect at 15k/18mo, then replace at 30k/36mo, 45k/54mo, 60k/72mo, 75k/90mo, 90k/108mo, 105k/126mo. First replacement at 30k/36mo, then every 15,000 miles / 18 months.
Appears at 30k/36mo, 60k/72mo, 90k/108mo. Pattern is every 30,000 miles / 36 months. If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.
Replace at 105,000 miles / 126 months. Install new plugs of the type as originally equipped.

First replacement at 105,000 miles (168,000 km) or 84 months (7 years). After first replacement, replace every 75,000 miles (120,000 km) or 60 months. Marked with * (recommended but not required for emission warranty). Use only Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent.
Appears under severe use essentials at 20k/24mo, 40k/48mo, 60k/72mo, 80k/96mo, 100k/120mo. Pattern is every 20,000 miles / 24 months under severe conditions.
Appears at every 10,000-mile / 12-month interval throughout the standard schedule (e.g. 20k/24mo, 30k/36mo, 40k/48mo, 50k/60mo, 60k/72mo, 70k/84mo, 80k/96mo, 90k/108mo, 100k/120mo, 110k/132mo).
Under severe use maintenance, replace brake fluid appears at every 10,000-mile / 12-month interval.
Replace CVT fluid appears as a severe use essential at 60k/72mo. Use only Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3 or equivalent.
Inspected at every 20,000-mile / 24-month interval (20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k). Use only Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3 or equivalent; do not mix with other fluids.

First inspected at 40k/48mo, then at 50k/60mo, 60k/72mo, 70k/84mo, 80k/96mo, 90k/108mo, 100k/120mo, 110k/132mo, 120k/144mo. Marked with * (recommended but not required for emission warranty). Check for wear, fraying or cracking and for proper tension.
Inspected at 20k/24mo, 40k/48mo, 60k/72mo, 80k/96mo, 100k/120mo, 120k/144mo. Marked with * (recommended but not required for emission warranty). Check vapor lines for leaks or looseness.

Inspected at 20k/24mo, 40k/48mo, 60k/72mo, 80k/96mo, 100k/120mo, 120k/144mo. Marked with * (recommended but not required for emission warranty). Check hoses, piping and connections for leaks, looseness, or deterioration.
Inspected at every 20,000-mile / 24-month interval. Visually inspect for proper installation; check for chafing, cracks, deterioration, and signs of leaking.
Inspected at every interval under both standard and severe use maintenance. Check for wear, deterioration and fluid leaks.
Inspected at every interval under both standard and severe use maintenance. Check for damage, looseness, and leakage of oil or grease.
Inspected at every interval under both standard and severe use maintenance. Visually inspect exhaust pipes, muffler and hangers for leaks, cracks, deterioration, and damage.
Inspected at every interval under both standard and severe use maintenance. Check for damage, looseness, and leakage of oil or grease.
Inspected at every interval under both standard and severe use maintenance. Check for damage, looseness, and leakage of oil or grease.
Inspected at every 20,000-mile / 24-month interval (20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k).
Inspect only if valve noise increases. Adjust valve clearance if necessary. Marked with * (recommended but not required for emission warranty). No fixed interval specified.

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent). If not available, synthetic 0W-20 GF-6 SP motor oil may be used.
fluids.capacity: 4-3/8 qt with filter change; 4 qt without filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. 50% antifreeze / 50% water mixture. Provides antifreeze protection to -34°F (-37°C).
fluids.capacity: 1-7/8 gal (with reservoir) — manual transmission; 1-7/8 gal (with reservoir) — CVT

fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3 (or equivalent). Do not mix with other fluids. Do not use ATF or manual transmission fluid.
Genuine NISSAN Manual Transmission Fluid (MTF) TL/JR Type 75W-75, or equivalent. If not available, API GL-4+, Viscosity SAE 75W-75 may be used as a temporary replacement.
Genuine NISSAN Brake Fluid or equivalent DOT 3 or DOT 4
Genuine NISSAN A/C System Oil Type PAG or equivalent
Genuine NISSAN Windshield Washer Concentrate Cleaner & Antifreeze fluid or equivalent
Unleaded regular gasoline with an octane rating of at least 87 AKI (Anti-Knock Index) / Research octane number 91. Do not use E-15 or E-85.

oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an oil and oil filter maintenance reminder and oil control system. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). The system must be reset after each oil and filter change via the Vehicle Information Display (4.2-inch Type A or 7-inch Type B).
severe_conditions: Driving for prolonged periods in dusty conditions (affects air cleaner filter and in-cabin microfilter replacement frequency)
Severe driving conditions requiring more frequent inspection of steering gear & linkage, axle & suspension parts, and drive shaft boots
extraction_caveats: 1. The schedule is presented as milestone-based (every 5,000 miles / 6 months) rather than a simple repeat-interval table; repeat intervals have been inferred by identifying the pattern across all milestones shown in the manual pages. 2. Engine coolant: first replacement at 105,000 miles or 84 months per page 456 and page 514 footnote (1); after first replacement, every 75,000 miles or 60 months per page 514 footnote (1). The schedule listing on page 514 shows 105k/126mo but the footnote clarifies 84 months for first replacement. 3. Intelligent Key battery: first inspected at 15k/18mo, first replaced at 30k/36mo, then replaced every 15,000 miles / 18 months (at 45k/54mo, 60k/72mo, 75k/90mo, 90k/108mo, 105k/126mo). 4. Engine drive belts: first inspection at 40k/48mo, then at every 10,000-mile interval thereafter; the interval is approximately every 10,000-20,000 miles but varies. 5. Manual transmission gear oil replacement appears only under severe use essentials (pages 505, 507, 509, 511, 513), not under standard essentials. 6. Brake fluid replacement appears at nearly every 10,000-mile standard interval as well as every severe interval. 7. Fuel tank capacity from page 518 is 12-3/8 gal US. 8. Engine coolant capacity from page 518 is 1-7/8 gal US for both manual and CVT variants.
